name: RC–B10–0157/2025 – § 7 – Am 31
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 7.Praises the invaluable contribution of civil society, in Syria and abroad, as the legitimate repository and defender of the aspirations of the Syrian people during years of brutal oppression; pays particular tribute to the White Helmets; calls for the EU to engage with churches to foster reconciliation and inclusive and civic dialogue, notably between ethnic, cultural and religious communities; calls, further, on the Commission to support churches in Syria providing humanitarian assistance and other essential social services for people in need regardless of their ethnic, religious or social background to foster pluralism, peaceful coexistence and trust within Syrian society;
